title: Tiny, cute cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cheese wedge body - main yellow triangle -->
  <polygon points='20,75 80,75 50,35' fill='#FFD94A' stroke='#FFE87A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  
  <!-- Top face of wedge (lighter) -->
  <polygon points='22,74 78,74 50,38' fill='#FFE87A'/>
  
  <!-- Front side face -->
  <polygon points='20,75 80,75 78,74 22,74' fill='#E8B830'/>
  
  <!-- Left side face -->
  <polygon points='20,75 50,35 50,38 22,74' fill='#F0C440'/>
  
  <!-- Right side face -->
  <polygon points='80,75 50,35 50,38 78,74' fill='#E8B830'/>
  
  <!-- Holes in the cheese - cute round holes on top -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='62' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#D4A020' stroke='#E8C040' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#D4A020' stroke='#E8C040' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#D4A020' stroke='#E8C040' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='50' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#D4A020' stroke='#E8C040' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='66' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#D4A020' stroke='#E8C040' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Cute face on the front -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3A2A10'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='68' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#3A2A10'/>
  
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='66.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8E0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='66.5' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8E0'/>
  
  <!-- Cute smile -->
  <path d='M44,73 Q50,78 56,73' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A10' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='73' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='73' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  
  <!-- Tiny sparkles around -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8D0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='45' r='1' fill='#FFF8D0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#FFF8D0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='1' fill='#FFF8D0'/>
</svg>
